title: Vize Release Transition
description: One durable atomic release transition: a single canonical record binding one release decision to the complete accepted anti-replay state, chained to its predecessor by canonical SHA-256 fingerprint. Host durability contract: a conforming host must write the complete canonical bytes to a temporary location, flush them to durable storage, then atomically rename or commit so exactly one complete chain tip exists at every instant; on recovery it must verify the tip against its retained predecessor before deciding anything new, and discard - never repair - a torn or partial record. Verification is fail-closed and identical across JavaScript, Rust, Go, and JVM hosts; the shared tests/fixtures/test-run-evidence transition-decision fixtures are the conformance source of truth for new host implementations.

admissionId.description: Exact test-run:<sha256> admission id; the only admissible form of accepted test evidence.

candidate.description: Exact release candidate the decision was made for. Application and environment must stay constant along one chain.

diagnostic.description: One retained diagnostic, shaped and serialized exactly like a live diagnostic.

decision.description: Retained allow-or-deny decision exactly as it was produced. allowed must agree with the diagnostics, and denialCodes must equal the published mapping of the diagnostics; verification rejects a record claiming an outcome its own diagnostics contradict.

format.description: Serialized format marker; readers must reject any other value.

formatVersion.description: Serialized format version; readers must reject a higher value until they explicitly support it.

sequence.description: One-based chain position; each transition extends its predecessor by exactly one.

previous.description: Canonical SHA-256 fingerprint of the predecessor transition; null only at genesis (sequence 1).

decidedAt.description: Millisecond-precision UTC instant of the decision; never earlier than the predecessor's.

accepted.description: Complete anti-replay state after this transition: every admission id ever accepted in this chain, sorted and unique. An allowed transition adds exactly its own evidence to its predecessor's state; a denied transition leaves the state unchanged; an already accepted id can never be accepted again.
